I am an old woman farming my small rice plot here near Kilimanjaro. My plot is very small, less than a third of a hectare, and I have no cash to waste on big bags of fertilizer — one bag is too much for my little plot and I cannot afford it anyway. I do what my mother did and what my neighbors do: I put the manure from my few animals on the plot, I plant the rice seed I kept from last harvest, and I work the plot with my own hands. Sometimes my daughter comes to help me when the weeding is heavy, but I do not have money to pay outside people.
